# awx_workflow_job_template_node_approval (Resource)

Manages an AWX workflow job template node approval through `/api/v2/workflow_approval_templates/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_workflow_job_template_node_approval" "demo_approval" {
  workflow_job_template_node_id = awx_workflow_job_template_node.demo_approval.id
  name                          = "Demo Approval"
  description                   = "Pauses the demo workflow until someone approves"
  timeout                       = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of this workflow approval template.
- `workflow_job_template_node_id` (Number) Database ID of the workflow job template node to convert into an approval.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this workflow approval template.
- `execution_environment` (Number) The container image to be used for execution.
- `timeout` (Number) The amount of time (in seconds) before the approval node expires and fails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID for this workflow approval template.
- `status` (String) Status

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <workflow_job_template_node_id>/<id>
import {
  to = awx_workflow_job_template_node_approval.example
  id = "1/2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <workflow_job_template_node_id>/<id>
terraform import awx_workflow_job_template_node_approval.example 1/2
```
